scope: G4 variable eye-vector input15.xyz used by native ps1.x VSPEC. Full XP/Win98 2001, fixed IQ and performance remain open.

evidenceOfMeaning.producer: tests/devices/geforce_specular.c runs unmodified native D3D8 HAL on original93.71 with ps1.1 SPEC (two different eye constants) and VSPEC.
evidenceOfMeaning.constantSPEC: Native compiler embeds constant eye vectors in FP inline data; it does not use input15.
evidenceOfMeaning.variableVSPEC: Native compiler emits MOVR1.xyz,INPUT15 followed by DP3/DP3/DIV/MAD and the dependent cube sample. This is the same sequence that stopped original2001. Native vertex outputs carry all four components of TEX1,TEX2,TEX3.
evidenceOfMeaning.inference: The native compiler identifies input15.xyz as the variable eye-vector input. Reconstructing it from these three already-routed texture interpolators follows that compiler evidence and the API contract; real-silicon exhaustive conformance is not claimed.

implementation: Pack TEX1.Q,TEX2.Q,TEX3.Q after perspective interpolation, independent of user clip-distance varyings.
Accept only observed MOV reads of documented XYZ lanes. Reject W-consuming swizzles/masks, relative reads and other unobserved input15 operations; no arbitrary zero or unit-vector fallback.

nativePairedProof.healthySource: build/nv40-xp-native-spec-triangles-fixed.state with its matching overlays (desktop checkpoint before sample launch)
nativePairedProof.before: Original VSPEC produces unsupported shader input15; originalAPI Draw/Present calls still return0 because submission is asynchronous.

after.nativeAPI: All three original CreatePixelShader/Draw/Present cases return0 and probe ends normally.

nativePairedProof.hostImages: Read-only original OS/game size and mtime checks pass; harness initialization status is not used to accept this independent probe.

validation: 175WGSLmodules including variable-eye/clip semantic linkage and explicit refusals
RealGPU: independently varied Q components yield exact expected RGB pixels
RealGPU: variable eye exactly matches a directly interpolated control vector with unequal homogeneousW
Strict standalone no-CRT MinGW build (excluding existing GetProcAddress cast diagnostic)
